Leaders Commemorate Syama Prasad Mookerjee on 125th Birth Anniversary

Various Indian leaders, including the Prime Minister and Chief Ministers, paid tribute to Syama Prasad Mookerjee on his 125th birth anniversary. Commemorations highlighted his contributions to national unity, education, and service. Some reports also noted specific events like the unveiling of a statue and the observance of holidays in educational institutions.
